title: Main Isotypic Formula For Semisimple Theta Data
body_html:
Main Isotypic Formula For Semisimple Theta Data

The theta draft aims to prove

$$ \omega[\psi_\beta|_{H_{\Sigma,+}}] = \sum_{\substack{w\in W\\ M(w)=\beta}} \sum_{\bar x'\in B(Z_{G'})} \omega_{x,x'(w,\bar x'),w}. $$

Equivalently, after fixing $w$ with $M(w)=\beta$, it records the consequence

$$ \omega[\psi_\beta|_{H_{\Sigma,+}}] = \mathcal H(G') \sum_{\bar x'\in\mathcal C(Z_{G'})} \omega_{x,x'(w,\bar x'),w}. $$

In the no-depth-zero case, the draft says $x'$ is determined by $w$ and

$$ \omega[\psi_\beta|_{H_{\Sigma,+}}] = \operatorname{cInd}_{S'_w}^{G'}(\omega_{x,x',w}). $$
proof_html:
Shape In The Draft

The intended proof is induction on the number of bricks:

  1. decompose the $G_{x,s^+}$-isotypic space into lattice-model support pieces;
  2. use the geometric lemma to move $M(w)$ into the diagonal part;
  3. split off the largest brick;
  4. correct the largest brick by the single-brick argument;
  5. apply the induction hypothesis to the remaining bricks.

Draft Caution

The current TeX has a proof skeleton but not a fully closed proof. This node should be treated as a partial proposition.
